<document id="atm-limits">
ATMˆwithdrawalˆlimitsˆHowˆmuchˆcashˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆoutˆeachˆdayˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆTheˆlimitˆcoversˆallˆATMsˆcombined,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆTheˆdailyˆlimitˆresetsˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆraiseˆmyˆlimit?ˆNo.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthemˆforˆaˆdayˆorˆmakeˆexceptions.ˆTheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆaˆhigherˆlimitˆisˆtoˆchangeˆplan.ˆ##ˆATMˆlimitsˆversusˆtheˆATM'sˆownˆlimitˆManyˆATMsˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆmaximumˆperˆwithdrawalˆthat'sˆlowerˆthanˆours.ˆIfˆyouˆneedˆmore,ˆyouˆcanˆmakeˆmoreˆthanˆoneˆwithdrawal,ˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆstaysˆwithinˆyourˆdailyˆlimit.ˆEachˆwithdrawalˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆmayˆcarryˆaˆfee.ˆCashˆwithdrawalsˆareˆneverˆcoveredˆbyˆCushion.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="plan-basic">
TheˆBasicˆplanˆBasicˆisˆTallowbrook'sˆfreeˆplan.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆ$0.00,ˆthere'sˆnoˆminimumˆbalance,ˆandˆyouˆgetˆtheˆsameˆapp,ˆdebitˆcardˆandˆsupportˆasˆeveryˆotherˆmember.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$0.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆOut-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆ$2.50ˆeach.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ3%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ0.50%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆnotˆavailableˆonˆBasicˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$3,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$500ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆInternationalˆwiresˆaren'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆthem.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆorˆsendˆmoneyˆabroadˆoften,ˆPlusˆorˆPremiumˆwillˆusuallyˆcostˆlessˆoverˆaˆyear.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-basic">
CushionˆonˆBasicˆCushionˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆdebitˆcardˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆCushionˆisˆpartˆofˆtheˆpaidˆplans.ˆIt'sˆhowˆweˆgiveˆmembersˆaˆlittleˆroomˆwithoutˆchargingˆoverdraftˆfees.ˆ##ˆGettingˆCushionˆMoveˆtoˆPlusˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00,ˆorˆtoˆPremiumˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆOverdraftˆfeesˆBasicˆhasˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00).ˆTransactionsˆthatˆwouldˆoverdrawˆyourˆaccountˆareˆdeclinedˆinstead.ˆ##ˆCanˆaˆBasicˆbalanceˆgoˆnegative?ˆOccasionally,ˆforˆexampleˆifˆaˆmerchantˆpostsˆmoreˆthanˆitˆauthorizedˆorˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆdepositˆrepaysˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆautomatically.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆdeclinedˆtransaction.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
